module:baileywiki-content.reason: From 1.0.21, Foundry VTT's listing gives every version the manifest URL of the newest. Each version's own manifest was at download.bailey.wiki/bcm/v<version>/module.json up to 1.0.36; from 1.0.37 its author publishes on foundrymods.com, whose manifest takes ?version= (from 1.0.19), but gives the newest for a version it does not hold.

module:fa-nexus.reason: Foundry VTT's listing names its versions 0.6.x and 0.5.x, though each one's manifest gives a version such as 0.6.2 or 0.5.3, and its GitHub tags add -beta (v0.6.2-beta), so neither is a version a client can install. Each version's own manifest is the release asset of its tag.

module:multi-token-edit.reason: The GitHub release 99.test is a test build, whose manifest gives version 3.2.2-test.
